root_cause.text: `mbox_controller_register()` in the Linux mailbox subsystem failed to validate that `struct mbox_controller->chans` was non-NULL before later using the channel array, so a controller registered without `chans` could trigger a NULL-dereference OOPS.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `!mbox->chans` to the sanity check in `drivers/mailbox/mailbox.c` (`if (!mbox || !mbox->dev || !mbox->ops || !mbox->chans || !mbox->num_chans)`), and the commit message explicitly says “Fail gracefully if there is no channel array attached to the mailbox controller. Otherwise the later dereference will cause an OOPS.”

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: `mbox_controller_register()` in the Linux mailbox subsystem failed to validate that `struct mbox_controller->chans` was non-NULL before later using the channel array, so a controller registered without `chans` could trigger a NULL-dereference OOPS.

Otherwise the later dereference will cause an OOPS.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a missing validation for mbox->chans during mailbox controller registration.
intent_record.what: The sanity-check condition in mbox_controller_register() was changed to also reject a controller when mbox->chans is NULL; the nearby "Sanity check" comment was removed.
intent_record.how: At runtime, registration now fails with -EINVAL if the mailbox controller has no channel array allocated, preventing the function from proceeding with an invalid controller state that could otherwise lead to misuse of the channels.

grouping_result.intent: Add a missing validation for mbox->chans during mailbox controller registration.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds validation for mbox->chans in mbox_controller_register() to prevent a NULL dereference when the channel array is missing.

candidates.rationale: This pre-fix sanity check validates several required fields but omits mbox->chans, allowing registration of a controller with a NULL channel array that is later dereferenced.

vuln_statements.explanation: This pre-fix validation omits a check for mbox->chans, so a controller with a NULL channel array could still be registered and later dereferenced, causing the NULL-dereference OOPS described in the root cause.
